the normal rat prostate produces a TGB‐β‐like growth inhibitory factor that is not detectable in normal rat prostate under physiological conditions.
the immature rat ventral prostate secretes a potent cell growth inhibitor that is similar to TGF‐β.
the immature prostate is a source of a potent TGF‐β.

the identification of a growth‐inhibitory factor produced by normal prostate.
the identification of the prostatic inhibitory protein, its purification, and its biological activity.
the study of the molecular biology of the human prostate and the development of a model system for the study of prostate growth and differentiation.

the TGF‐β family of growth factors plays a major role in the regulation of the prostate growth and differentiation.
the prostate is a source of TGF‐β.

the immature rat prostate produces a TGB‐β‐like growth inhibitory factor.
